body:
Founder real-time: 'redgarden build is failing.' Root cause: scripts/build_arena.sh (Linux sanity-check step) and ci.yml's Windows mingw cross-compile are separate, redundant build paths from scripts/build.sh -- both were missed when tree_passive_mod.c landed (same gap class bloodflower_mod.c hit before, its own prior comment named this exact risk). Fixed both, verified bash scripts/build_arena.sh exits 0 locally. REDGARDEN da1a4ca.

⚓ ☃
title: CI fix -- wired tree_passive_mod.c into build_arena.sh + Windows cross-compile
